$comment: Per-suite wall-clock durations (ms) for the general-server vitest lane, used by scripts/general-server-shard.mjs to balance suites across the PR shard matrix (pr-trusted.yml general_tests). Refreshed 2026-11-14 from the per-file times that vitest prints in the General tests job logs of PR runs 43525294898, 43488585377 and 43412221333: each suite that finished in any of those runs carries its mean time across the runs it finished in (failed suites included, since their timeouts are real cost). Suites that never finished in those runs (they sat in shards cancelled at the 20 minute limit) keep their earlier value multiplied by 1.16, the observed ratio of new to older times across the 587 suites seen in both. conversation-frame and heartbeat-managed-scheduler never finished inside 20 minutes in any of the three runs, so both carry a 1000000 ms lower bound instead of a measurement. Refresh the same way when shard jobs drift apart or approach the job limit: a general-server job takes about 34s + 1.05 x summed suite time + 2.9s per suite. The 2026-09-15 baseline came from PR runs 35036001734 and 35024948947; this manifest sums to far more because suites have grown and it now also holds the managed Native suites that earlier rows lacked. Timings are scheduling data only, not acceptance evidence.
